name: Your Company
tagline: Tattoos you will still be proud of in twenty years
niche: Tattoo studio: custom designs, blackwork, fine line and cover-ups

listing.description: A website for a tattoo studio, piercer or illustrator. Black ink with an acid accent: a flash sheet whose drawings ink themselves line by line, ink drops trailing the cursor and a portfolio where each design floods with colour on hover.

seo.title: Your Company — tattoo studio in Tashkent: custom designs
seo.description: Custom tattoos in Tashkent: blackwork, fine line, ornament and cover-ups. Single-use needles, a sterile room, free consultation and sketch.
seo.answer: Your Company is a tattoo studio at 7 Muqimiy Street in Tashkent, open Tuesday to Sunday from 12:00 to 21:00. Mini tattoos start at 400,000 sum, an hour of tattooing is 600,000 sum, a full day 3,500,000 sum. Consultation and sketch are free, needles are single-use; book on Telegram. We tattoo clients aged 18 and over.

sections.title: Your Company
sections.subtitle: We draw your design from scratch instead of copying the internet. Blackwork, fine line, ornament and cover-ups — in lines that will not blur over the years.

sections.label: Studio
sections.title: Every design is drawn once
sections.text: Three artists and one sterile room in an old house on Muqimiy. We do not repeat other people’s work: at the consultation we listen to your story, draw a design and revise it until you say yes. Needles and caps are single-use and every surface is cleaned after each guest.

items.text: A classic motif in fine line, 3 hours.

items.title: Swallow

items.text: A star with a suzani pattern.

items.title: Snake

items.text: A daughter’s name in the banner.

items.title: Rose
items.text: A ready design — yours if you want it.

items.title: Consultation
items.text: We meet or call, talk through the idea, placement and size. Free.

items.title: Design
items.text: The artist draws your design within a week and refines it with you.

items.title: Session
items.text: We transfer the stencil, check the fit and tattoo. Breaks whenever you need.

items.title: Healing
items.text: You leave with a healing film and aftercare notes. A touch-up after a month is free.

items.quote: I came with a Pinterest picture and left with a design nobody else wears. Thanks to Nigora for her patience.
items.author: Sevara

items.quote: They covered the script I got at nineteen. Now there is a snake and I love it.
items.author: Behzod

items.quote: My first tattoo and I was scared. Madina explained everything, we took a break and forty minutes later it was done.
items.author: Lola

items.a: It depends on placement: the wrist and forearm barely register, the ribs more so. We pause whenever you ask.
Eighteen, with ID. We make no exceptions.

items.q: How long does a design take?
items.a: Usually a week. Minis and flash from our sheet can be done on the day of the consultation.
Yes, 200,000 sum when you book a session — it counts towards the price.

items.q: How do I look after it?
items.a: Peel the film after 3–5 days, then use cream and avoid sun and pools for two weeks. We give you written notes.

sections.label: Booking
sections.title: Tell us your idea
sections.text: Write on Telegram: what you want, where and roughly how big. Send references if you like — we will draw our own.
